answer: Harberger lotus plot: each identity holds one lotus plot, assessed above a nadir floor of 40, taxed each epoch. Anyone may buy a plot at its price, so a plot at the nadir is bought out. The tax follows a spiral: first plot 20 per epoch, k-th 20+2(k-1), so 1,000 fakes bleed 1,019,000 per epoch plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented lotus plots fail: tax falls on the key-bound holder. An honest agent pays 20 per epoch and keeps its plot.
